tactics:
induction x generalizing x_1 with
| nil => exact hnil x_1
| cons a as ih => exact hcons a as x_1 (fun bs' => ih (bs' :: x_1))

induction x generalizing x_1 with
| nil => simp only [List.flatMapM.loop]; exact hnil x_1
| cons a as ih => simp only [List.flatMapM.loop]; exact hcons a as x_1 (fun bs' => ih (bs' :: x_1))

induction x generalizing x_1 with
| nil => rw [List.flatMapM.loop]; exact hnil x_1
| cons a as ih => rw [List.flatMapM.loop]; exact hcons a as x_1 (fun bs' => ih (bs' :: x_1))
induction x generalizing x_1 <;> unfold List.flatMapM.loop <;> simp_all
